prompts.identity: Use case: stylized-concept. Production Vietnamese RPG EARTH FIGHTER character atlas. Input images are STYLE references only. NEW male fighter with the strongest and heaviest silhouette of the party: massive broad torso, thick neck, thick powerful forearms, extremely wide shoulders, sturdy short legs and huge hands, visibly larger muscles than the slender Mage/Archer. Masculine square-jawed youthful face, close-cropped dark hair with a small high topknot, warm bronze skin. Earth ochre and brown sleeveless combat vest, sandstone and antique bronze angular shoulder/forearm plates, rugged leather waist belt, dark wide trousers, heavy stone-toed leather boots. Practical Vietnamese fantasy textile trim, restrained amber stone crystal inserts. Weapon: one large two-handed rectangular stone WAR HAMMER with bronze braces and a thick wooden handle, complete weapon attached to hands. No flowing mage robes. Row 2 poses: grounded hammer-ready RIGHT holding it low in both hands; hammer raised above shoulder beginning a heavy smash RIGHT; wide planted finishing hammer strike RIGHT, hammer forward and low but not into the ground; defensive RIGHT guard braced behind the hammer. Emphasize heavy grounded mass in every stance. Precisely EIGHT isolated FULL-BODY figures in a FOUR-column by TWO-row atlas of ONE IDENTICAL character with the same face, head/body size, costume and weapon in every cell. Row 1: idle FRONT/down, idle RIGHT profile, idle BACK/up away, idle LEFT profile. Row 2: four RIGHT-facing battle poses as specified. Entire weapon, boots and clothing must fit comfortably inside each equal cell with wide transparent gutters. Mild overhead orthographic sprite camera; consistent row ground baseline. Painterly 2.5D soft textured shading, fine material highlights, compact 3.5–4-head proportions, readable at 80px tall, matching the supplied Mage/Archer brushwork but much more muscular. No labels, text, grid lines, scenery, ground plane/shadow, particles, magical haze, checkerboard or opaque backdrop. REAL RGBA transparency outside the figures.
prompts.finalCore: Use case: precise-object-edit. The reference image is the exact character design to PRESERVE: face, hair, muscles, costume, colours, weapon and all eight pose identities. Re-layout this same eight-pose sprite atlas into a PORTRAIT canvas with exactly TWO columns and FOUR rows, NOT four columns/two rows. Each cell is wide enough for its complete weapon; generous fully transparent gutters at least 40px between all silhouettes. Row 1: idle front and idle right. Row 2: idle back and idle left. Row 3: ready right and overhead attack preparation right. Row 4: finished attack right and defensive guard right. The adjacent weapon tips currently touch other characters: separate every figure completely and finish every weapon tip without any neighbouring body behind it. Preserve one consistent head/body scale and original strong muscular silhouette across all eight poses. Full feet and weapon must remain inside each cell with empty margins. No background, ground shadow, labels, text, gridlines or VFX. REAL alpha transparency outside every figure. Prefer portrait 1024 by 1536 or 1536 by 2048; wide cells and visibly clear spacing matter more than filling the canvas.
prompts.run: Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted 2.5D Vietnamese RPG RUNNING SPRITE ATLAS, real transparent RGBA. Input image is the EXACT character design, weapon, face, muscular body and costume to preserve. Exactly SIXTEEN isolated full-body running figures in FOUR columns by FOUR rows on a square canvas, preferably 2048x2048. Row 1: RUNNING RIGHT four successive phases; Row 2: RUNNING DOWN toward camera four phases; Row 3: RUNNING UP away from camera four phases with back visible; Row 4: RUNNING LEFT four phases. A real alternating stride: column 1 left leg forward/right leg back, column 2 passing feet, column 3 right leg forward/left leg back, column 4 airborne recovery. Same face/head and muscle/body scale throughout, consistently mild overhead orthographic camera. Each figure occupies only about 65–70 percent of its cell height; generous transparent space on ALL four sides, including below feet. Weapon held close to torso diagonally forward/down while running; complete weapon tip and all feet inside the SAME cell. Every silhouette must be disconnected from every neighbouring pose, at least 30px of fully transparent gutter. Keep the original masculine strong body and broad shoulders in ALL directions, not a slimmer mage body. Refined soft painterly shading and metal/fabric texture consistent with Archer/Mage. NO text, labels, grid lines, floor, shadow, environment, spell VFX, haze or opaque background. Actual alpha transparency outside each figure. Character-specific invariants: a heavy rectangular stone hammer with amber insert and bronze braces; dark small topknot; ochre sleeveless combat vest, heavy stone/bronze bracers and armour, very thick torso/arms/legs.

layout.core: 2 columns x 4 rows: idle down/right/up/left, ready/windup/strike/guard
layout.run: 4 columns x 4 rows: right/down/up/left, four phases each

runtime: 160 x 112 logical pixels, resolution 3, foot anchor (80,104). Fixed body scale; complete silhouette extraction.
scope: Character art + rehearsal preview; gameplay skills and balance not implemented.
